projects.title: Cinematic E2E - Before the Last Train

setup.title: Cinematic E2E - Before the Last Train
setup.storyBrief: In 20 seconds, a young woman waits alone on a nearly empty urban platform, gripping a black phone as the clock nears the last train. A silent, unreadable notification arrives. She chooses neither the train nor the past: she pockets the phone, exhales, and walks toward the warm station exit. Cool uncertainty gives way to quiet hope.
setup.creativeDirection: Create a photorealistic vertical YouTube Short with restrained drama and balanced pacing. Begin in cool blue-hour stillness, tracks consistently on camera-left and the warm exit on camera-right. Use damp concrete, subtle reflections, realistic station lighting and close details of breathing, eyes, clock and phone. Keep the woman’s identity, proportions, hairstyle and wardrobe exact. Never show another person. The notification must remain unreadable. End on her walking into warm light, with no sentimentality or beauty filter.

storyRoleSlots.label: Young Woman
storyRoleSlots.storyFunction: Carries the entire visible emotional decision and provides continuity from uncertainty to hope.
storyRoleSlots.relationshipHint: Alone; the phone and train function as unseen emotional pressures, not characters.
storyRoleSlots.objective: Decide whether to remain tied to the past or leave the platform and move forward.
storyRoleSlots.emotionalArc: Tense and watchful; briefly destabilized; quietly resolute and lighter.
storyRoleSlots.performanceDirection: Play everything internally. Use restrained eye shifts, shallow breathing, a small release in the jaw, and one clear exhale; avoid tears, melodrama, or a triumphant smile.

storySourceVersions.storyBrief:
At an almost empty urban train platform late in the evening, a young woman
waits with a black phone in her hand for someone from her past. The platform
clock and the approaching last train force a decision. A silent notification
arrives, but instead of boarding or continuing to wait, she exhales, puts the
phone away and walks toward the warm station exit. The story moves from quiet
uncertainty to a small but clear act of letting go. Show only the selected
Character; no second person appears on screen.
storySourceVersions.creativeDirection:
Photorealistic contemporary vertical-drama cinematography. Preserve the
selected Character's exact identity, apparent age, body proportions, hairstyle
and approved wardrobe in every shot. Use one believable modern urban train
platform at blue hour: cool ambient station light, one warm practical light
near the exit, slightly damp concrete, restrained reflections and realistic
public architecture. Keep screen direction consistent: the tracks remain on
camera-left and the warm exit remains on camera-right. Performance is subtle
and human, with natural blinking, breathing and small eye movements. No beauty
filter, fantasy styling, readable signs, logos, extra people, duplicate person,
identity drift, wardrobe changes or invented accessories.

scenes.title: Blue-hour platform
scenes.purpose: Establish her solitary wait and the approaching last train.
scenes.storyChange: Platform pressure becomes personal and immediate.
scenes.location: Nearly empty urban station platform; tracks camera-left, warm exit camera-right
scenes.time: Blue hour, nearing the last train
scenes.transitionIntent: Cut from waiting stillness into phone detail.
scenes.blocking: She stands alone beneath the station clock, gripping a black phone at chest level.
scenes.lighting: Cool blue-hour station light, damp-concrete reflections, warm exit camera-right.
scenes.performance: Internal restraint, shallow breathing, brief eye shift toward the clock.
scenes.audioIntent: Low station hum and distant rail ambience; no dialogue.
continuityNotes: Tracks remain camera-left and exit camera-right.
Maintain exact identity, proportions, hairstyle, and wardrobe.
Never show another person.

shots.title: Clock and waiting face
shots.blocking: She remains beneath the clock, phone held tightly at chest level.
shots.performance: Still posture, shallow breath, eyes flick briefly toward the clock.
shots.lighting: Cool blue-hour light with restrained practical warmth in the background.
shots.environment: Damp concrete platform, subtle reflections, empty track area camera-left.
shots.audioIntent: Station hum and faint distant train vibration.
shots.prompt: Photorealistic vertical medium close-up of the exact same young woman beneath a station clock, gripping a black phone on a damp blue-hour platform; tracks camera-left, warm exit camera-right, restrained push-in, no other people.
continuityNotes: Exact identity, hairstyle, proportions, and wardrobe throughout.

shots.title: Phone in her hand
shots.purpose: Focus attention on the object tying her to the past.
shots.blocking: Her fingers tighten around the black phone.
shots.lighting: Cool reflected station light across the phone and damp skin.
shots.environment: Platform texture and soft reflections remain visible.
shots.audioIntent: Muted rail ambience; no notification yet.
shots.prompt: Tight photorealistic insert of the same woman’s hand gripping a black phone on a damp station platform, cool blue-hour reflections, screen unreadable, no logos or legible text.
continuityNotes: Phone remains black and screen content unreadable.

scenes.title: Silent notification
scenes.purpose: Let the past intrude through a silent phone alert, destabilizing her without revealing its meaning.
scenes.storyChange: The unreadable notification turns waiting into an immediate personal decision, setting up her choice to leave.
scenes.location: The same nearly empty urban platform beneath the station clock; tracks remain camera-left and warm exit camera-right.
scenes.time: Continuous blue hour, moments before the last train.
scenes.emotionalEnd: Briefly destabilized, with the first hint of resolve.
scenes.transitionIntent: Hard cut from the preceding phone insert to the screen lighting, then drift to her eyes as the arriving train draws her attention toward the tracks.
scenes.blocking: She holds the black phone at chest level. It vibrates once and lights. Her thumb freezes; she looks down, then slowly toward the tracks camera-left without stepping forward.
scenes.lighting: Cool blue station light shapes her face and damp surroundings; a faint, natural phone glow touches her fingers. Keep the warm exit subtly present camera-right.
scenes.performance: Play the impact internally: one restrained flinch in the thumb, shallow breath, a small tightening of the jaw, then a controlled eye shift toward the train. No tears, dialogue, or melodrama.
scenes.audioIntent: A single muted vibration interrupts the low station hum. Distant train movement grows slightly, then holds beneath her silence.
continuityNotes: Notification text, sender, and any identifying content remain completely unreadable.
Preserve the exact identity, proportions, hairstyle, and wardrobe from adjacent scenes.
Tracks stay camera-left and exit camera-right.
Never show another person, silhouette, or reflection of another person.
The phone remains black and in her hand through the end of this scene.

shots.title: Unreadable interruption
shots.purpose: Deliver the silent notification as the personal intrusion.
shots.framing: Extreme close-up vertical insert of the phone and her fingers.
shots.blocking: The black phone lights in her grip; her thumb stops mid-motion as the vibration passes.
shots.performance: Only the frozen thumb and a slight finger tension reveal the impact.
shots.lighting: Cool reflected platform light with a faint, non-dominant screen glow.
shots.environment: Damp concrete and soft blue reflections; no legible signage or background figures.
shots.audioIntent: One muted vibration, with the station hum continuing underneath.
shots.prompt: Photorealistic vertical extreme close-up of the same young woman’s hand holding a black phone as it lights with a completely unreadable notification on a damp blue-hour urban platform; no logos, no legible text, no sender identity, no other people, cool realistic reflections.
continuityNotes: Keep every screen character and sender detail unreadable.
Phone remains black and physically consistent with the preceding insert.

shots.title: Choice in her eyes
shots.purpose: Show destabilization and the pressure of the approaching train without dialogue.
shots.cameraMovement: Very slow lateral drift from the phone toward her eyes.
shots.blocking: She lowers the phone slightly, raises her gaze toward tracks camera-left, and remains planted beneath the clock.
shots.performance: A restrained eye shift, shallow breath, slight jaw tension followed by minimal release; her expression stays unreadable rather than tearful.
shots.lighting: Cool blue light across her face; restrained warm exit bokeh remains camera-right, with no beauty filter.
shots.environment: Empty damp platform, subtle reflections, no footsteps, silhouettes, or additional movement.
shots.audioIntent: Distant train rumble and low station hum; no dialogue and no notification sound beyond the earlier vibration.
shots.prompt: Photorealistic vertical tight profile close-up of the exact same young woman on a nearly empty damp urban platform, shifting her eyes from a black phone with an unreadable screen toward tracks camera-left; cool blue-hour light, subtle warm exit bokeh camera-right, restrained internal drama, no tears, no smile, no other people.
continuityNotes: Maintain exact face, hairstyle, proportions, and wardrobe.
End with her still facing the tracks, ready for the following scene’s pocketing action.
Do not reveal any readable phone content.

scenes.title: The warm exit
scenes.purpose: Resolve the decision through a simple physical action and hopeful movement.
scenes.storyChange: She pockets the phone, exhales, and leaves the platform toward warmth.
scenes.location: Same platform leading to warm station exit camera-right
scenes.time: Continuous blue hour into warm station light
scenes.transitionIntent: Match cut from phone to pocket, then follow her exit.
scenes.blocking: She pockets the phone, exhales once, turns away from the tracks, and walks camera-right.
scenes.lighting: Cool platform light transitions naturally into warm practical station light.
scenes.performance: One clear exhale, shoulders release subtly, no triumphant smile.
scenes.audioIntent: Exhale foregrounded; train recedes; soft footsteps toward exit.
continuityNotes: She chooses neither the train nor the past.
Tracks remain camera-left; exit remains camera-right.
End before she disappears completely.

shots.title: Pocket and exhale
shots.blocking: She pockets the black phone, exhales, and turns camera-right.
shots.performance: Jaw releases; one clear exhale; understated expression.
shots.lighting: Cool light on her back, warm exit beginning to shape the frame.
shots.audioIntent: Clear exhale over receding train ambience.
shots.prompt: Photorealistic vertical medium close-up of the same young woman pocketing a black phone and exhaling on a damp urban platform, turning toward the warm exit camera-right; cool blue-hour light, restrained hope, no smile, no other people.
continuityNotes: Phone is no longer visible after being pocketed.

shots.title: Walk into warmth
shots.purpose: End on quiet hope and forward motion.
shots.blocking: She walks alone from the cool platform toward the warm exit camera-right.
shots.performance: Steady, lighter pace; relaxed but not triumphant posture.
shots.lighting: Natural transition from cool blue platform light into warm station practicals.
shots.environment: Damp reflective concrete, nearly empty station, no visible people.
shots.audioIntent: Soft footsteps, station hum, train fading behind her.
shots.prompt: Photorealistic vertical wide rear three-quarter shot of the same young woman walking alone from a cool blue-hour platform into a warm station exit camera-right; tracks camera-left, damp reflections, restrained hopeful ending, no sentimentality, no beauty filter, no other people.
continuityNotes: Final frame preserves warm exit direction and continuous wardrobe identity.
